topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The space around me feels too wide, the walls seem to stretch further than they did before. Each step to this new area is measured, careful. The air is different here, holding scents I don't recognize, mingling with the familiar that clings to my clothes, remnants of where I've been. My movements are slow, as if through thick water, each action deliberate. I scan the area, eyes lingering on new faces, trying to gauge the territory, to understand the unwritten rules of this place. Tasks wait, but the edges of the room, the unwelcoming silence, make each one loom larger, more daunting. I focus on the task at hand, hands shaking slightly as I reach for the papers, each sheet a new challenge.
